overview: At home you put the queen at a hedge and left her there. The gardener is not yet a man with a name. You did not write a parliament, and you did not finish the day.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Added a few lines at the foot of Sunday's sheet and did not finish them.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote the queen as far as the hedge

summary: Wrote the queen as far as the hedge
